data.one_liner: Create and extract ZIP archive files in Android, iOS and macOS.
data.what_it_does: Creates and extracts ZIP archive files using native Android, iOS, and macOS platform APIs. It supports zipping directories recursively or specific file lists, unzipping to directories, and reporting progress.
use_when: You need to create ZIP files from directories or lists of files in Flutter apps.
You need to extract ZIP files on Android, iOS, or macOS.
You require progress reporting or selective extraction/compression of ZIP entries.
avoid_when: You need support for platforms other than Android, iOS, and macOS.
You prefer a pure Dart implementation instead of native platform APIs.
strengths: Uses Android/iOS/macOS platform APIs for high performance and optimal memory usage.
Runs background processing to keep the UI responsive.
Provides progress reporting and selective file inclusion/exclusion.
weaknesses: Limited platform support (only Android, iOS, and macOS).
Requires minimum platform versions (Android API 24+, iOS 13+, macOS 10.15+).
data.setup_notes: Requires minimum platform versions: Android API level 24+, iOS 13+, and macOS 10.15+.

alternatives.name: archive
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a pure Dart implementation for working with various archive formats across all Flutter platforms.
